name: Hearthlift Courier V3 · Difficulty 1 · Simplified Interaction
natural_language: Load the ember crate and wake the lifts. Carry it across the replayed lift stacks. Click the courier in the overhead chart, then click an intended landing spot to hop. BURN CRATE releases the crate. CANCEL AIM cancels aiming. The aim sets speed for a nominal 1.6s hop; elevation and inherited lift motion change the landing. Click a moving lift top in the overhead chart to inspect its concealed motor survey. Its next 3.2s of motion then appears in both views and remains retained while you decide. Inspect safely from the quay before hopping; inspection does not launch the courier; each deliberate hop resolves the next replay. Land inside a top, burn at the hearth, and certify. Falling or releasing away from the hearth ends the episode. A rejected CERTIFY DELIVERY also ends the episode. Aim previews, canceled aims and rejected out-of-range aims remain recoverable.
